name: animated-headline
title: Animated Headline
description: A headline that reveals word-by-word with a 3D flip-up, rotates its last word on a timer, and draws a gradient shimmer underline that resizes to each word and replays on every swap. A recreation of the x.ai hero effect.
docs: Render <AnimatedHeadline prefix="Engineering things people love to" words={["build", "design", "ship", "use"]} /> for the composed effect, or import the named pieces <RotateAppearance />, <RotateWord />, and <ShinyUnderline /> separately. All animation is CSS-owned: prefix words flip up with keyframes, the rotating word uses CSS enter/exit keyframes while React briefly keeps the exiting word rendered, and the underline uses CSS reveal/shimmer keyframes. Honours prefers-reduced-motion by rendering the settled state. Requires the hero-word and hero-underline keyframes (installed automatically via the css field).
